pages.title: Feed and purpose
pages.text: The Silicon Arc Furnace uses Nether quartz and charcoal to produce metallurgical-grade silicon. It also needs a carbon electrode with durability remaining.$(br2)Check the arc-furnace process in JEI for input positions and quantities.

pages.title: Batch operation
pages.text: One batch processes one set of inputs. Connect power and load the feed and electrode. The furnace charges, runs its high-power arc, melts the batch, and taps the result.$(br2)Power demand varies by phase. Inputs lock during a batch; check electrode durability and collect both silicon and slag.

pages.title: Production line
pages.text: Send metallurgical silicon to the $(l:siliconic:chlorination_reactor)chlorination reactor$(/l) and slag to the $(l:siliconic:reprocessor)reprocessor$(/l). A worn electrode can produce extra slag.$(br2)Comparator output tracks batch progress. Keep the furnace away from precision manufacturing rooms.
